rules.logic: Fires when analytics alert `Kubernetes secrets enumeration for the first time` and analytics alert `Unusual Kubernetes secret access` both observe the same user_username (Kubernetes service account) from the same sourceIPs within a 10-minute window, stitching the first-seen enumeration and the anomalous read into one CDR credential-theft incident.
rules.name: SIM-CDR-026 first-time enumerate-then-harvest secret theft
